groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Three strokes on the left: a hand doing something.

chars.story: A hand lifting boxes onto a truck: you are moving house.
chars.note: Moves heavy things or the whole household.

chars.story: A hand grabs a jar and shakes it back and forth.
chars.note: Also 'to row' and 'to crank'. 搖 became 摇 on the right side.

chars.story: A hand yanks a weed up by the root.
chars.note: 海拔 'altitude' is literally 'sea-pulled-up'.

chars.story: A child runs in and his hand smacks the door: bump.
chars.note: Also 'to run into someone by chance'.

chars.story: A hand pulls a heavy bag along the floor: drag.
chars.note: Slippers are 'drag-shoes'.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 彐 broom head
chars.story: A hand pushes a broom over the floor: sweep.
chars.note: 掃 had a full broom 帚 on the right; only its top 彐 is left.

chars.story: A hand flings seed out across the field: cast.
chars.note: The 'let go' sense gives 撒谎, 'cast a lie'.

chars.story: A hand gropes along the dark wall for the switch.
chars.note: Feeling with the fingers, often without seeing.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops: wet, liquid, rivers.

chars.story: Water churns and tumbles over itself: it rolls.
chars.note: Also 'to boil' and the rude 'get lost'. 滾 became 滚 on the right side.

chars.story: A boat takes you across the water: a ferry crossing.
chars.note: Also 'to get through': 渡过难关.

chars.story: Water washes a thing until it is spotless: clean.
chars.note: 潔 had a complex right side; 洁 uses the simple 吉.

chars.story: Water that comes out of the eye: tears.
chars.note: 淚 had 戾 on the right; 泪 puts the eye 目 there instead.

chars.story: Water wrapped in a thin skin: a bubble.
chars.note: Also 'to soak' or 'to steep', as in 泡茶.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 日 sun + 业 shape
chars.story: Water on the cloth, the sun not yet there to dry it: wet.
chars.note: 濕 had a much fuller right side; only 氵 on the left is easy to see.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth: speaking, shouting, blowing.

chars.story: Our mouths say 'self' together: we, you and I included.
chars.note: Colloquial and northern: it includes the person you are talking to.

chars.story: A mouth asking about the thing in the house: what?
chars.note: Dialect for 什么. Common in speech and dialogue.

chars.story: Mouth meets mouth: a kiss.
chars.note: 吻合 'match up' is the figurative use.

chars.story: A mouth opened as wide as it goes: shout.
chars.note: Calling to someone at a distance.

chars.story: A mouth hums to show it has heard and agrees.
chars.note: An interjection: 'mm', 'uh-huh', 'hm?'. Not a word with a meaning of its own.

groups.title: yawn 欠
groups.note: A figure with an open mouth: breath going out, or a lack.

chars.story: A mouth stretched open sends the breath out: blow.
chars.note: 吹牛 'brag' is literally 'blow a cow'.

chars.story: An axe put down, the mouth stretched wide in a grin: joyful.
chars.note: 欣赏 is 'to enjoy and appreciate'.

chars.story: A mouth open to confess what is lacking: an apology.
chars.note: Heard in 'sorry' and in 歉收 'a poor harvest'.

groups.title: gate 门
groups.note: A gate: doors and what goes through them.

chars.story: A person pops out of the gate in an instant: a flash.
chars.note: 閃 had 門; the gate was simplified to 门.

chars.story: A gate barred with a plank: nobody goes anywhere, so idle.
chars.note: 閒 and 閑 are older forms; 闲 is the modern one.

chars.story: A market crowding at the gate: noisy and busy.
chars.note: 鬧 was a gate with fighting figures; 闹 is gate plus market.

chars.story: A gate-building where each person climbs up: a pavilion.
chars.note: 内阁 'cabinet' is the government sense.

groups.title: heart 忄 心
groups.note: Feelings: 忄 on the left, 心 below.

chars.story: The heart clings to what is gone: cherish it.
chars.note: 可惜 'pity' is the commonest word.

chars.story: The heart kept in the middle, never leaning away: loyalty.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; modern 忠 is about loyalty to a person or cause, not rulers only.

chars.story: The heart settles and the wound closes: heal.
chars.note: Also 'the more': 愈…愈…, like 越…越….

chars.story: A heart caught on something and unable to rest: worry.
chars.note: His Analects card 憂 is 'worry' with a tall, complicated shape; 忧 is a new, short form with 忄 on the left.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing: roles, copies, claims.

chars.story: Every person arrives with the full kit: all present.
chars.note: Almost always seen in 俱乐部 'club' (a borrowed word).

chars.story: A person acting a part he does not own: forged.
chars.note: 偽 had 為; 伪 uses the simplified 为.

chars.story: A person's little child: the young one.
chars.note: In 仔细 it means 'careful'. Also used for young animals.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: Two strokes: speech.

chars.story: Words sent out for a birthday: the celebration of birth.
chars.note: Formal; 圣诞 'Christmas' is the word you will see most.

chars.story: The doctor asks questions and looks closely: a medical exam.
chars.note: A medical exam, not a general one.

chars.story: Words set out in rows for everyone to read: a chart.
chars.note: 离谱 'off the chart' means unreasonable.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Plants and wild ground.

chars.story: Grass tossed back and forth on rippling water: shaken about.
chars.note: The sense is of unrest more than of a gentle sway.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 亡 lost + 川 river
chars.story: Grass grows wild where the river has taken the field: desolate.
chars.note: Also 'absurd' in 荒谬.

chars.story: A vine of green leaves hung with fruit: grape.
chars.note: Only appears in 葡萄 'grape'. Pairs with 萄.

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: A foot on a road: walking, patrolling, obeying.

chars.story: Walking along the streams to check each one: making rounds.
chars.note: Also counts rounds of drinks.

chars.story: Walking round with a net of watchmen: patrol.
chars.note: In 逻辑 'logic' it stands in a borrowed word.

chars.story: Walking the road your superior honors: you comply.
chars.note: Used for rules, laws and instructions.

groups.title: follow, offer, restrain
groups.note: Obeying, giving and holding in.

chars.story: Steps taken one behind another, shield up: follow.
chars.note: Follows a track or a rule.

chars.parts: - two hands lifting a gift up to a person
chars.story: Hands raised to give something to a superior: offer.
chars.note: Respectful giving, also 'to serve'.

chars.parts: 廾 two hands + 戈 spear
chars.story: Two hands gripping a spear to stay on guard: guard against.
chars.note: Also 'to give up a habit', like smoking.

chars.story: A cord wound round and round a thing: tied up.
chars.note: 綁 became 绑; 糸 became the short 纟 on the left.

groups.title: clothes 衤
groups.note: Two strokes and a hook: things you wear.

chars.story: The part of the clothes where the arm comes out: sleeve.
chars.note: 领袖 'leader' is literally 'collar and sleeve'.

chars.story: Clothes that store both legs: trousers.
chars.note: 褲 became 裤 with the simplified 库.

groups.title: death
groups.note: Bodies, graves and loss.

chars.story: A body lying flat: a corpse.
chars.note: Also the 'body' part in 屁 局 尺.

chars.parts: - a cross over a collapsing figure
chars.story: The cross over a figure that crumples: what is lost.
chars.note: 喪 had two mouths and 亡; the new shape drops them. Also 'funeral'.

chars.story: Earth heaped on someone after the sun has set: a grave.
chars.note: The most direct word for a burial place.

chars.story: A cloud-like ghost drifting out of the body: the soul.
chars.note: Used for the spirit of a person.

groups.title: leap and spin
groups.note: Fast movement.

chars.story: A foot pushes off the ground hard: leap.
chars.note: 躍 became 跃; the foot sits on the left.

chars.story: Soldiers' feet circling a flag: revolve.
chars.note: The flag's 方 shape is partly hidden on the left.

chars.story: A horse bounds up off the ground: soar.
chars.note: 折腾 'toss about' is also common.

groups.title: flesh 月
groups.note: The moon-shaped sign on the left: body parts.

chars.story: The fleshy front of the body where the heart sits: chest.
chars.note: Also the breast or the heart-mind.

chars.story: Branching streams in the flesh: veins.
chars.note: 山脉 'mountain range' is its veins of land.

chars.parts: 爫 claw + 子 child + 乚 hook
chars.story: A hand holds a child against the breast: milk.
chars.note: Used for the breast and for milk in compound words. The formal word: 乳制品 'dairy'; in speech milk is 奶.

groups.title: animals
groups.note: Livestock, herding, bugs.

chars.story: A cow kept alive for use: a farm animal.
chars.note: 牺牲 'sacrifice' is the word you will meet most.

chars.story: A hand taps the cow along with a stick: herd.
chars.note: 牧师 means a Christian pastor.

chars.parts: - a worm or insect curled up
chars.story: A worm curled up on the ground: an insect.
chars.note: The bug sign on many words for insects. 蟲 had three; 虫 keeps one.

groups.title: metal 钅 金
groups.note: Metal and its shine.

chars.story: The thin edge of the metal blade: its edge.
chars.note: 鋒 had 夆 on the right; 丰 replaced it.

chars.parts: 监 watch over + 金 metal
chars.story: A polished bronze plate you watch yourself in: a mirror.
chars.note: 借鉴 'learn from others' is the common use.

groups.title: rooms and buildings
groups.note: Places to stay.

chars.story: A hole in the wall that lets the light in: window.
chars.note: Also a 'window' on a computer screen.

chars.story: A long cloth stretched out as a tent.
chars.note: Also a variant of 账 'account' in 算帐.

chars.parts: 亼 roof + 干 pole + 口 mouth
chars.story: A small roof, a pole and a door: lodging.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'stop' (that was the older 捨). Modern 舍 also means 'give up'.

chars.story: A plot of earth measured and walled: a temple.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; in modern use it is a Buddhist temple or a mosque.

chars.story: Earth packed up high to make a wall.
chars.note: 隔壁 'next door' is literally 'the wall between'.

groups.title: manner and quality
groups.note: Things worth having, and how things look.

chars.story: A face seen close up, every line plain: how someone looks.
chars.note: Bound form: it needs a partner, as in 礼貌 'politeness'.

chars.story: A tap at every moment, so quick to respond: sensitive.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; modern use is 'sensitive' or 'quick-minded'.

chars.story: A piece of jade kept carefully: precious.
chars.note: 珍惜 'cherish' is the commonest word.

chars.story: A drum added to the party to cheer someone on: praise.
chars.note: Formal; 嘉宾 is the common word.

chars.story: At home you give yourself room to stretch out: relax.
chars.note: 舒服 'comfortable' is the common word.

chars.story: The sun overhead brings warmth.
chars.note: 暖气 is central heating in northern China.

groups.title: wood 木
groups.note: A tree: trees and what comes from them.

chars.story: A tall tree rustling beside the road: poplar.
chars.note: Also a very common surname. 楊 became 杨.

chars.story: A beam of wood laid sideways across the door: horizontal.
chars.note: Also the horizontal stroke in a character.

chars.story: A wooden board hung at the roadside with names: a ranking list.
chars.note: 榜样 'role model' is an example to follow.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: Female figure: people and the roles around them.

chars.story: A shifty figure beside a woman, up to no good: crafty.
chars.note: Seen in 汉奸 'traitor' and in crime words such as 强奸 'rape'. 姦 became 奸.

chars.story: She turns her head and wrinkles her nose: dislike.
chars.note: Also 'suspicion': 嫌疑 and 嫌犯 'suspect'.

groups.title: names and borrowed sounds
groups.note: Surnames, places and foreign words.

chars.story: A river that bends and breaks its course: Zhejiang province.
chars.note: A place-name character: the short name of Zhejiang.

chars.parts: - a bent figure on a tall stand
chars.story: A figure on a high stand: tall.
chars.note: Also a common surname, Qiao. 喬 became 乔.

chars.story: A grassy plant with sharp-scented white flowers: jasmine.
chars.note: A name character: seen in 茉莉 'jasmine' and in girls' names.

chars.story: A feather quill for writing: a brush.
chars.note: A transliteration character in names like 约翰 'John'. Literary 'brush'.

chars.story: A bow tied across with bars so it cannot shoot: not.
chars.note: A literary 'not'; also a transliteration character in names.

chars.story: A mouth adds sip after sip of dark liquid: coffee.
chars.note: A borrowed-word character; the 咖啡 pair is almost its only use.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: One picture each.

chars.parts: - a mouth holding a sweet bit inside
chars.story: A mouth with something sweet kept inside: willing to take it.
chars.note: As 'sweet' it appears in 甘草 'licorice' and 甘蔗 'sugar cane'.

chars.parts: 厂 cover + 十 cross + 目 eye
chars.story: A shield held in front of the eye: protection.
chars.note: 矛盾 is a spear against a shield.

chars.parts: - a tall dish on a stand, full of beans
chars.story: A tall dish heaped with beans.
chars.note: 土豆 'potato' is literally 'earth bean'.

chars.parts: - a hand stretched along a measuring rod
chars.story: A hand laid along a rod: ten Chinese feet.
chars.note: 丈夫 'husband' is the word you will meet.

chars.parts: 夂 trailing foot + 冫 ice
chars.story: Footsteps trailing out onto the ice: winter.
chars.note: Also 'winter' in 冬眠 'hibernate'.

chars.story: A child's hand poked through a hooked opening: a hole.
chars.note: Also the surname Kong: 孔子 is Confucius.

groups.title: other shapes
groups.note: Parts that join into one idea.

chars.story: A stone cracks and breaks into small bits: shatter.
chars.note: Broken into small pieces.

chars.story: Bamboo strips woven so you can watch the load: a basket.
chars.note: 籃 became 篮; 摇篮 'cradle' is a shaking basket.

chars.parts: 毌 pierced bar + 贝 shell
chars.story: A cord threaded through a shell: thread through.
chars.note: His Analects card 貫 is the same word; 貝 on the bottom became 贝.

chars.parts: - two hands holding up an offering
chars.story: Two hands raise an offering: present, play music.
chars.note: Also to present to the emperor.

chars.parts: - a brush held steady above a still base
chars.story: A brush held steady over the page: solemn.
chars.note: 肅 had a complex bottom; 肃 simplified it.

groups.title: service and trust
groups.note: Working for or entrusted to others.

chars.parts: - a bowed eye, like a servant looking up
chars.story: A servant's eye lifted to his master: a minister.
chars.note: Same shape as his Analects card; in modern prose it appears in 大臣 'minister' and in history.

chars.story: A bird at the door that comes to work: hire.
chars.note: Paying someone to work for you.

chars.story: A brace at the side of the cart: assist.
chars.note: 輔 became 辅 with the simple 车 on the left.

chars.story: Putting a thing under another's roof for safekeeping: mail.
chars.note: Also 'to lodge' and 'to depend on'.

sentences.en: Does the heating work in the winter?
She is absorbed in rock music.
A light breeze stirred the surface of the lake.
They looked up to him as their leader.
The baby fell asleep in the cradle.
When you're done sweeping, I'll mop.

sentences.zh: 我至今还珍惜你十年前给我的项链。
sentences.en: I still cherish the necklace you gave me ten years ago.

sentences.zh: 使用这个信息时，我当然会遵循您的要求。
sentences.en: When using this information, I will of course follow your requirements.

sentences.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。
sentences.en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.
